༄༅/ /bde mchog dang rdo rjai rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba mkha' spyod bde lam bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog dang rdo rjai rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba mkha' spyod bde lam bzhugs/

na mo tsakra saṃ ba ra ye/ 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog ya brten pa'i 'pho ba'i nyams len paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa gzhir byas te 'jug pa bde bar dgod par bya ba la/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ / rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs pad nyi'i steng*/ /bla ma kun 'dus 'khor lo sdom pa ni/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i dbang sngon ltar/ /rab brjid rnam thar sgo bzhi dag pa'i zhal/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag pa'i phyag bcu gnyis/ /dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje phag mo la/ /'khyud cing snyoms par 'jug pa'i gnas gsum du/ /rdo rjai gsum mtshan hūṃ yig 'od zer gyis/ /rang bzhin gnas nas rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /bcom ldan bde mchog yab yum ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med gyur/ /he ru ka dpal bdag nyid che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug ma/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo bcas la 'dud/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa yi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'bul/ /sdig ltung thams cad so sor bshags/ /dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang*/ /'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag bzhugs gsol/ /'dis mtshon dge kun bde mchog gi /go 'phang dam pa thob phyir bsngo/ /rang lus dbus su dbu ma mda' smyug tsam/ /mar sna lte 'og yar sna tshangs bug zug/snying kar rang sems hūṃ sngon nas 'bru tsam/ /'phar zhing 'phur la khad pa nyid du gyur/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bde mchog yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rjes bzung byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog thun dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su drang du gsol/ /zhes pa lan nyer gcig re brjod pa'i mthar/ ༈ de ltar gsol bas rje btsun thugs ka nas/ /'od zer lcags kyu lta bu glog 'khyug bzhin/ /rang gi spyi bor dhū ti'i nang brgyud de/ /rnam shes hūṃ la btab nas gyen du drangs/

/zhes brjod cing 'og rlung gyen du 'then pa dang mnyam du hika zhes brjod de hūṃ yig tshangs pa'i bu gar mgo nyug tsam re byas nas/ ka zhes brjod cing slar snying kar 'debs/ de lta bu lan nyer gcig re byas nas/ yang gsol 'debs nas bskyar te nyer gcig pa lan ci nus byas nas mthar rje btsun yab yum spyi bo nas snying khar byon nas hūṃ yig la thim par bsam zhing*/ rang gi sems dang bla ma lhag pa'i lha gsum dbyer med du mos pa shugs drag bya'o/ /de ni sbyong ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ rang 'chi ba'i tshe 'debs na 'phen pa las 'bebs pa mi byed de yang lan re gnyis tsam gyis mi chog gi 'chi ba'i dus kyi bar lan mang du bya dgos so/ /de'i tshe sngar gyi gsol 'debs kyi mthar tu/ /rje btsun nyid kyi thugs kar thim gyur te/ mkha' spyod gnas gshegs rnam shes thugs ka nas/ phyir 'thon mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin par gyur/ hika phaṭa ces dmigs pa dang bcas brjaud cing bsngo smon bya'o/ /maṅgalaṃ/ /༈ na mo badzra wā ra hi ye/ 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten pa'i mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba'i nyams len zhig bshad par bya ste/ de yang nā ro chos drug dang ni gu chos drug nas 'byung ba ltar rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang paṇa chen gong ma sogs kyis bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang nas 'chad pa la/ bde mchog gi rnal 'byor ba lta bu zhig gis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid bde mchog tu sgom pa'i rgyun yin na des chog la/ min na/ /rang nyid skad cig gis bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par gyur/ rang gi lus kyi nang sgal tshigs la nye bar rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug tsam mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi nas zug cing*/ yar sna tshangs bug dang khad chad du yod pa/ rang gi gsang gnas su chos 'byung zur gsum pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du rlung dkyil g.yo ba gzhu lta bu/

dhū ti'i mar sna'i bug pa'i nang du rang gi sems nyid a dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can 'phar la khad 'phur la khad pa zhig tu gyur/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rang gi rgyab nas phrag pa la bkal ba/ thod bskam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ dbu skra sil bus sku stod khebs shing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ gcer mo'i gzugs can gsang ba'i chu skyes dmar sing nge ba rang gi tshangs bug gi thad du gnas pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' spyod kyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badzra wa ra hi arghaṃ nas/ shapta pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod yod na 'bul/ rgyal kun lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos/ /sgyu ma'i gar rol lha mo'i gzugs/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dud/ /ces bstod nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyaid mdzad yum/ /gsol ba 'debs so rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ / thugs rjes gzigs shig rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /bla ma kun 'dus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /mchog gsum kun 'dus rdo rje rnal byor ma/

/dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su khrid du gsol/ /yi dam kun 'dus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /mkha' 'gro kun 'dus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /zhes lan bdun nam/ nyer gcig lta bu re brjod cing mthar 'og rlung gyen du 'then pa dang 'og rlung g.yos/ spyi bo'i rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu zhig byung ste/ rang sems a yig la zug nas gyen du drangs/ hig ces brjod pas de nyid hril gyis song nas tshangs bug la reg tsam byas nas 'og rlung lhod pa dang slar mar 'bebs/ de ltar lan mang du byas na 'byongs pa'i rtags 'byung*/ yang na sbyong ba'i tshe/ dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ /zhes pa zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes bsgyur yang rung*/ mthar rje btsun ma dang de'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'babs a yig la thim par bsam mo/ /de ni sbyong ba'i dbang du byas la/ rang 'chi bar nges pa'i tshe/ hig phaṭa ces brjod pas/ rnam shes a yig tu gsal ba de nyid tshangs bug nas rgyangs kyis 'thon/ rje btsun ma'i gsang gnas dmar sing nge ba'i nang du zhugs nas thugs kar thim pas rje btsun ma mkha' spyod du gshegs/ rnam shes thugs ka nas phyir 'thon mkha' spyod kyi rig pa 'dzin par gyur par bsams la bsngo smon bya'o/ /de lta bu lan re gnyis tsam gyis mi chog pas/ 'chi ba'i dus byed pa'i bar bya zhing*/ gzhan la 'debs pa dang kha bsgyur tshul shes par byas nas bya'o/ /'di'i 'pho ba la rlung stobs kyis 'pho ba dang*/ 'dun stobs kyis 'pho ba gnyis bshad pa'i phyi ma'i dbang du byas la/ rlung stobs kyis 'pho nus na rang gang 'dod par 'pho nus la/ 'dun stobs la de tsam mi nus kyang phan che'o/ /ces pa 'di gnyis ka dam pa'i man ngag bzhin shākya btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis re gnyis la phan 'dod kyi bdun pas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo//
//maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ bde mchog dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba mkha' spyod bde lam bzhugs/ -PAGE 352- -PAGE 353- - PAGE 349-
